parameters.query: SELECT bgc.use_ask($1) AS questions, bgc.ask_limit() AS lim

SELECT CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN bgc.memory_for($1, $2) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END AS mem, (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT g.title), '[]') FROM rule_docs d JOIN games g ON g.id = d.game_id WHERE d.status = 'ready') AS rule_games

SELECT CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN bgc.shelf_view($1, 'mine', NULL) END AS own, bgc.friend_by_name($1, $3) AS fid, CASE WHEN bgc.friend_by_name($1, $3) IS NOT NULL THEN bgc.shelf_view($1, 'friend:' || bgc.friend_by_name($1, $3), NULL) END AS visit

SELECT bgc.lookup_games($1, $2::jsonb) AS games, CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN bgc.buy_pool($1) END AS pool, bgc.curator_card() AS curator, CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN bgc.friends_pool($1) END AS fpool, bgc.asker_extras($1) AS extras, (SELECT top_games FROM members WHERE google_email = $1) AS top_games, CASE WHEN $5::boolean THEN bgc.rule_search($2::jsonb, $6) END AS rules

'tests' : n === 'Look At Photo' ? 'photo' : 'nathan', model: j.model || null, cost: u.cost, in: u.prompt_tokens, out: u.completion_tokens }; }))] }}
